command.stdin_python:
import json
from pathlib import Path
from company_wiki.source_catalog import narrative_reading as reading
from unit.document_understanding_selection.test_reading_native_carriers import source_fixture
cases=['技术服务业务本期实现收入人民币26.5亿元，同比增长16.2%。', '技术服务业务本期实现营业收入人民币26.5亿元，同比增长16.2%。', 'Our Diagnostics services revenue was USD 26.5 million during the year.', 'Our Diagnostics services revenue increased to USD 26.5 million during the year.', '项目1在本节作介绍，具体内容另述。', '客户2号账户的余额为172万元。', 'Our software services revenue was 26.5% of group revenue during the year.', '公司的新产品收入占比提升至超30%。']
for text in cases:
 f=reading.detect_reading_business_fact(text);p,q=source_fixture([(text,)])
 c,m,_,complete,w=reading._candidates(p,q)
 print(json.dumps({'text':text,'eligible':f.eligible,'exempt':f.financial_exempt,'purpose':f.purpose,'reasons':f.reasons,'candidates':len(c),'bands':[v.get('value_band') for v in m.values() if not v.get('context_only')],'complete':complete,'withheld':[r['reason'] for r in w]},ensure_ascii=True))
